det.doc: Maps (canonical ingredient code + preparation STATE) → a food-safety advisory that applies ONLY in that state (Future-Features SAFE — founder chose the prep/state context). E.g. `huevo` + `crudo` → salmonella caution; `porotos` + `crudo` → toxina danger. Content is PROVENANCE-TAGGED via `source_kind` (`official` | `ai_default`), `source_ref` NOT NULL — same two-tier disclosure as IngredientWarning. Rows ship ahead of the recipe-level trigger: a rule fires into a recipe's `avisos` when that recipe uses the ingredient in `state_tag` (the state signal is wired in a follow-up; the table + content come first). System-owned.
A dietary preference entry for soft filter (D17).
D108 dietary input — two sections: allergens[] (hard) + preferences[] (soft).
D109 + D109-rev Path A+ exploration input — five soft-BIAS controls.
D109 + D109-rev PATCH body for ``/settings/exploration`` — WHOLESALE REPLACE semantics.
Household shared format defaults — serving must be an allowed value.
Maps a canonical ingredient code → an allergen-restriction code it BREAKS (R8 / #38).

Maps a canonical ingredient code → an INTRINSIC food-safety advisory it carries (Future-Features SAFE). A SOFT advisory — *how not to mishandle* (e.g. "los porotos crudos contienen fitohemaglutinina; hervir 10 min") — kept DISTINCT from the HARD allergen wall in `IngredientRestriction` (*who can't eat*). Content is PROVENANCE-TAGGED (founder D-PH-1 revised): `source_kind` is `official` (an authoritative citation in `source_ref`, e.g. FDA/MINSAL/WHO) or `ai_default` (no official source found — the advisory is an AI-suggested default and the UI DISCLOSES it as such). `source_ref` stays NOT NULL. `aviso_code` is the stable id surfaced in the derived `recipes.avisos`. System-owned.
Notification category toggles (cooking, shopping, pantry).
Independent privacy toggles (shopping data, culinary prefs, reminders).
An allergen/restriction entry for hard SQL filter (D17).
Two-section dietary profile (D108): allergens[] (hard SQL filter) + preferences[] (soft).
User personal format preference — display language.
A cooking household — the tenant boundary for pantry, recipes, shopping.
Everything a first-run user submits to finish setup and create their household.
A person, identified provider-agnostically (Firebase today, portable tomorrow).

Advance a long-prep session. ``expected_stage`` is the stage the client believes the session is on — advancing is optimistically concurrent (a stale/retry value is a safe no-op replay), so a double-tap can't skip a stage.
Completion counters. ``actual_portions`` is the total cooked; ``portions_stored`` (0 ≤ stored ≤ actual) are set aside as a prepared pantry item, the rest eaten.
A cook-photo binary attached to a cooking session (H8, founder-ratified D144).
A cook-photo's metadata (H8 / D144) — NEVER the bytes. GET the binary route (``/cooking/sessions/{id}/photos/{slot}``) for the actual image.
An active or completed cooking session.
Durable per-stage reminder for a long-prep cooking session (REQ-16 / SC-07).
Per-step progress within a cooking session.
Append-only dish history — feeds profile aggregates.
Paginated dish history (Phase 13 T1).
A user notification — read/delete state is user-owned.
Cached profile summary for fast Perfil landing (Batch 7).
Source/photo readiness patch (Phase 14; photo upload storage deferred).

Start/replace or clear a session's per-step timer (H7, founder-locked 2026-07-08). ``step_id`` + ``duration_seconds`` BOTH set starts/replaces the timer; BOTH null clears it; a mixed body is rejected (422). The SERVER clock computes ``timer_ends_at`` — never trusts a client-supplied instant, so the countdown survives an app kill/reinstall.
A durable stage reminder for a long-prep session (SC-07).
Pause/continue a multi-day session (Phase 14). ``reminder_at`` is only meaningful with ``pause`` — supplying it on ``continue`` is rejected.
A single acceptance of the privacy policy + terms, at a policy version.
Assign a pantry item to a storage location (Phase 15).
One ranked canonical candidate a typed line could map to.
One confirmed row to create. Mirrors PantryItemCreate but is collected in a batch; the row must carry a resolved canonical code (pick-or-drop guarantees this — no unverified rows).
Per-row outcome: the created item (on success) or an error message (on failure). The index ties the result back to the request row so the client can report partial failures precisely.
A resolved input line: parsed quantity + ranked candidates + confidence band. `candidates` is empty when confidence is `low` (the UI forces pick-or-drop so the pantry stays canonical).
A canonical entry Gustify publishes for Boletapp's receipt-item picker.
Gustify `GET /api/v1/catalog` publish shape (ETag-cacheable per ADR).
Wraps a read that may be stale because the last sync was a while ago.
Connection + resilience config for the deferred live wiring.
One canonical ingredient the household adds often — feeds the batch-add quick-pick strip.
Append-only ingredient history — source is compra/receta/descarte.
A non-persisted shopping suggestion (frequent or planned-recipe gap).
FLAT delete result (D84) — the new status + whether a history event was logged.
A storage location in a household. Exactly one principal `Despensa` is protected.
A current-state inventory row — what is believed to exist in the household pantry.
Pantry overview + the cookability summary (F1.1).
Per-item decision in a reset operation: keep / discard / move.
A pantry reset operation — scope + summary. Idempotency-required.
A request to ingest a user's receipt items into the household pantry.
Summary of an ingest run. mapped_pending = mapped items whose pantry append is DEFERRED until the wiring phase (D43).
One receipt line item published by Boletapp.
Boletapp `GET /boletapp/v1/users/{email}/receipt-items` response envelope.
Raw typed lines (one product per line, optional inline quantity). Capped for DoS safety: at most MAX_BATCH_LINES lines, each at most MAX_LINE_LENGTH chars (enforced pre-handler).
Acknowledgement for POST /account/export (Phase 15 stub).
How many cooked dishes fell in a given complexity level (1-5).
D109 + D109-rev Path A+ — the five soft-BIAS explore controls, surfaced read-only.
Top-line counts for the Perfil landing history strip.
A taxonomy code (cuisine type / technique) with its cooked-dish count.
Per-user RAW progression signal on a node (roast M2/M3).
A user's progress toward learning one technique or ingredient (REQ-14).
A progression tree (config) — one per kind (technique, region, diet, flavor).
One learned skill on the home screen's 3-most-recent unlock list (REQ-14 / SC-04).
A prerequisite/suggests edge between nodes — EMPTY at MVP (roast M5); here for the DAG.

Per-tree mastery for the profile's progression breakdown (Phase 5, per-tree additive). One per progression tree (technique/region/diet/ingredient); ``technique`` is also the headline proficiency_tier. ``level`` is None when the user has no live progress in that tree.
A node in a tree — one taxonomy code, seeded from the taxonomy (M5 pure extractor).
Cooked-dish count for one ISO week, keyed by its Monday (YYYY-MM-DD).

A derived food-safety advisory for a recipe (Future-Features SAFE) — the SOFT "how not to mishandle" layer, DISTINCT from the hard allergen list (`restriction_codes`). `source_kind` drives the client provenance badge: 'official' shows the `source_ref` citation; 'ai_default' shows an AI-suggested disclosure. `state_tag` is null for intrinsic advisories, the prep state (e.g. 'crudo' / 'mal-cocido') for conditional ones.
A canonical ingredient entry. Referenced by pantry items (Batch 3+).
PUT /recipe-filter-modes/{mode_id}/cupo body: the taxonomy ``tipo`` code to attach.
One cupo-bearing saved mode with both derived counters.
The user's cupos plus the tier-derived slot cap (ONE pool with Saved Modes, D186).
Novelty-filtered explore results for one mode (Phase 16, REQ-09).
A pipeline-surfaced candidate (novelty + allergen filtered). Not persisted — structure-only until real generation lands (REQ-08, PENDING #22).

Body for ``POST /recipe-creation/gustify`` — the explore mode to generate for. ``model_tier`` (D95) picks the Gemini tier: lite (default, flash-lite, 1 credit) | full (flash, 3 credits). Additive with a default → OpenAPI stays additive.
Result of an AI generation attempt (D-GU3 pipeline).
Per-call cost/latency/tokens for one AI generation (REQ-19). Structure-only today (mock provider → cost 0, fixture tokens, real measured latency).
Optional POST /recipes/{id}/plan body (F6, additive): the cupo slot this plan is made through. Omitted/None = the pre-F6 manual plan, unchanged.
A recipe planned for cooking — household-scoped.
A recipe — system-seeded, user-created (manual), or Gustify AI generated.
Pantry-availability projection for a recipe (Phase 13 T4).
A recipe creation request — manual or Gustify AI.

Captured DEMAND from a 0-result recipe search (2026-06-22). When a search returns nothing, the user can explicitly ask Gustify to create recipes for it: we record the UNMET SEARCH (the filter selection that returned 0) + an optional ≤140-char note, for later ON-DEMAND authoring — NOT real-time generation. status: pending → fulfilled. household nullable (context only).
POST body for capturing a 0-result search demand ("Pedir recetas", 2026-06-22).
Acknowledgement of a captured demand (the row is fulfilled later, off-band).
A critical piece of equipment a recipe needs (Phase 9 / SCHEMA-ENRICH, migration 0044).
One critical piece of equipment a recipe needs (Phase 9 / SCHEMA-ENRICH).

The resulting per-user flags after a PATCH (D93).
PATCH body for per-user recipe flags (D93). Only the provided fields are set; an omitted (None) field leaves the existing value untouched (partial update).
An ingredient line in a recipe.

One long-prep stage (#69 / REQ-16). ``hold_hours`` = the minimum wait after ENTERING this stage before the next is due — the exact shape ``services/long_prep.py`` reads (label ≤ 120 = the reminder column width; hold clamped 0..8760 = the reader's one-year cap).
An ordered step in a recipe.
One generated-recipe ingredient resolved against the canonical catalog (#39 / D72).
Per-user favorite/archived flags for a (platform-shared) recipe (D93, Phase 41c).
